# Secret-scan allowlist.
#
# One path per line. '#' starts a comment. Paths match as a substring, so a
# directory entry covers every file beneath it.
#
# Only DELIBERATELY FAKE test fixtures and DOCUMENTATION PLACEHOLDERS belong
# here. A real credential must never be allowlisted: if the scan is wrong, fix
# the scan. Adding a real key to this file hides it from every future scan and
# from every reviewer.
#
# scripts/scan-secrets.js re-scans THIS FILE with the PEM and bot-token patterns
# and exits 2 if it finds something, so a real secret pasted in here fails the
# build.

# Fake Telegram bot tokens used by the bot regression suites.
apps/backend/tests/fixtures/telegram.ts

# Fake tokens and log-redaction fixtures.
apps/backend/tests/log-redaction.test.ts

# The CI workflow references secret NAMES in its env block; those are names, not
# values, but the assignment pattern matches long uppercase identifiers.
.github/workflows/ci.yml

# Documentation showing the PEM envelope as an .env example: a quoted literal
# containing backslash-n escapes and an ellipsis, not key material. Line 61 of
# the same file shows the same shape for the public key. The envelope is
# described rather than reproduced here, because this file is itself scanned.
docs/TELEBIRR_INTEGRATION.md
